Name: On Wednesdays We Wear Pink
Author: KaileyStardew
Description:
On Wednesdays, Krobus wears pink.
Krobus's portraits and sprites now have a pink bow (or other fashionable pink regalia) on Wednesdays. 

[img]https://i.ibb.co/MVR34cc/config-1.png[/img]
As of version 1.0.3, you can now configure when Krobus wears pink! Wednesdays are the only day on by default.


[img]https://i.ibb.co/JmHVzN3/compatibility.png[/img]
Airyn has kindly added compatibility for this mod to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17059]Diverse Stardew Valley[/url]!


[img]https://i.ibb.co/s1Z754v/credits-1.png[/img]
Portrait bow originally by [url=https://kandipatterns.com/patterns/misc/cute-pink-bow-11628#]AliceElectrikk[/url].
